how: the strong-CP statement holds given its premise, which is borrowed and not derived: Hermitian Yukawa matrices with determinants of one sign at the Pati-Salam scale (left-right D-parity), and a vanishing gauge theta there. Main's own argument for the running (checks/agy002_g0_g1.py): with beta_Y = P(H_u, H_d) Y the logarithmic derivative of det Y is Tr P, and the trace of a word of length at most three in two Hermitian matrices is real, so arg det(Y_u Y_d) does not run at one and two loops for any Yukawas. Its numerical residuals and its J_CKM values are its own runs; main has no matrix two-loop running yet
